mapper.select: SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT 4;

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id
WHERE 1=1
AND m.sport IN
#{sport}
AND (
m.age_20s = true
m.age_30s = true
m.age_40s = true
m.age_50s = true
m.age_60_plus = true
)
AND (
m.skill_intro = true
m.skill_beginner = true
m.skill_intermediate = true
m.skill_advanced = true
)
AND m.gender = #{gender}
AND m.region IN
#{region}
AND m.match_date >= #{startDate}
AND m.match_date <= #{endDate}
AND ( m.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC LIMIT #{startIndex}, 4

SELECT m.*, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id
WHERE m.latitude BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND m.longitude BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng}
AND m.sport IN
#{sport}
AND (
m.age_20s = true
m.age_30s = true
m.age_40s = true
m.age_50s = true
m.age_60_plus = true
)
AND (
m.skill_intro = true
m.skill_beginner = true
m.skill_intermediate = true
m.skill_advanced = true
)
AND m.gender = #{gender}
GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC

SELECT m.*, u.nickname, COUNT(p.participant_id) AS current_people FROM personal_match m LEFT JOIN personal_match_participant p ON m.personal_match_id = p.personal_match_id LEFT JOIN user u ON m.user_id = u.user_id WHERE m.personal_match_id = #{personaMatchId} GROUP BY m.personal_match_id ORDER BY m.created_at DESC;
